About the Tournament

Melbourne’s Most Competitive
T10 Cricket Event

Darebin Chargers League is proud to present the T10 Championship 2026 — a fast-paced senior cricket tournament bringing competitive teams together for an exciting short-format competition across Melbourne’s northern suburbs.

The tournament runs from 22 August to 6 September 2026, with games on Saturdays and Sundays at grounds in Epping, Lalor and Thomastown.

With 16 teams competing through 4 league games, Quarter Finals, Semi Finals and a Grand Final, every ball counts. Matches are played with Kookaburra white balls under qualified umpires, with Man of the Match medals awarded every game.

The tournament features 16 elite teams competing across Lalor, Epping and Thomastown.

Tournament Format

How It Works

24 teams across four knockout stages. 10 overs per side — fast, electric cricket from ball one.

1
League Stage
All 24 teams play 4 league games. Points determine Quarter Final seeding.
›
2
Quarter Finals
Top teams advance to Quarter Finals. Single-elimination knockout matches.
›
3
Semi Finals
The final four compete. Two spots in the Grand Final on the line.
›
4
Grand Final
The championship decider. One team lifts the trophy and $10,000.
